asset_set: Questionnaire Q11 option 2 — Volunteering at community health camp

art_style.fill_technique: solid flat fills with optional 8–12% ambient shade on curved surfaces only
art_style.shading: single cel shadow ellipse under kit and forearms — no cast shadows on transparent edge
art_style.texture: none on skin; subtle woven texture on blanket edge via 3 parallel lines max
art_style.mood: warm community-care energy — approachable volunteer service, not a clinical hospital scene
reference_vibe: KursoKo approved RIASEC sticker line weight
art_style.match_family: Same 2px ink and flat fill language as RIASEC stickers — but NO letter glyph and NO colored border frame
forbidden: die-cut sticker border or white card frame

accent.name: lavender
accent.use: first-aid cross icon, volunteer vest trim

color.background: fully transparent — no floor plane, no vignette, no cream fill behind scene
color.lighting_tint: faint warm #FFF8F0 highlight on knuckle tops only
color.accent_rule: lavender appears on 2–3 small areas max — not a background wash

lighting.highlight: small curved highlights on kit lid and blanket fold edges
lighting.shadow: flat #2D2D2D at 12% opacity under hands and table objects

pose.camera_distance: medium-close — hands occupy lower 55% of frame

left_hand.action: passes the first-aid kit across the community table
left_hand.grip: full palm under kit base, fingers curled on the near edge
left_hand.position: lower-left quadrant, wrist angled toward center

right_hand.action: receives the kit from a second volunteer's forearm entering frame-right
right_hand.grip: fingers reaching to steady the kit handle

pose.gesture_summary: mid-handoff freeze frame — teamwork passing supplies
pose.framing: crop at mid-forearm — no elbows, no face, no torso

subject.scene_narrative: Two pairs of forearms meet over a simple community table, mid-handoff of a first-aid kit. A neat stack of folded blankets sits nearby, ready to distribute. The gesture captures the quiet teamwork of a volunteer health camp — supplies moving hand to hand, calm and organized, with warmth rather than urgency.

primary_objects.name: first-aid kit
primary_objects.detail: rounded lavender cross icon on the lid, dark handle clasp

primary_objects.name: folded blanket stack
primary_objects.detail: three folded layers with a teal ribbon tie

primary_objects.name: volunteer armband
primary_objects.detail: worn on the receiving forearm, plain no text

subject.environment: light wooden community table strip across bottom third — fades to transparent at edges

composition.layout: converging handoff line from left kit-passing hand to right receiving hand
composition.negative_space: transparent margin top and sides — 48px safe zone for card crop
depth_layers: background: table edge only — no wall
composition.thumbnail_readability: kit silhouette + two meeting hand shapes readable at 160px width

generation.negative_prompt: face, portrait, person head, text, watermark, logo, red cross medical brand, letter S, border frame, sticker outline, photorealistic, 3d render, cgi, blurry, dark background, clinical hospital, injury, blood, distress
